Read layout placeholders

Source: R/layout.R
read_layout_placeholders.Rd

Read layout placeholders

read_layout_placeholders(
  pptx,
  layout,
  keep_all = FALSE,
  error_call = current_env()
)

Arguments

pptx

A PowerPoint wrapped in a <pptx_container> object. see load_pptx()

layout

layout

keep_all

if FALSE, only keep non missing placeholders

error_call

The execution environment of a currently running function, e.g. caller_env(). The function will be mentioned in error messages as the source of the error. See the call argument of abort() for more information.

Value

A tibble with columns describing the layout placeholders:

layout_file

character; basename of the layout file

layout_name

character; name of the layout

id

character; placeholder id

offx

numeric; x offset in inches

offy

numeric; y offset in inches

cx

numeric; width in inches

cy

numeric; height in inches

ph_type

character; placeholder type

ph

character; placeholder XML node as glue object

ph_id

character; placeholder idx attribute

layout_ph_name

character; placeholder name

The tibble has a dimensions attribute containing the slide size.

Examples


pptx <- example_pptx()
read_layout_placeholders(pptx, layout = "Title Slide")
#> # A tibble: 5 × 11
#>   layout_file      layout_name    id  offx  offy    cx    cy ph_type ph    ph_id
#>   <chr>            <chr>       <int> <dbl> <dbl> <dbl> <dbl> <chr>   <glu> <chr>
#> 1 slideLayout1.xml Title Slide     2  0.75  2.33  8.5  1.61  ctrTit… <p:p… NA   
#> 2 slideLayout1.xml Title Slide     3  1.5   4.25  7    1.92  subTit… <p:p… 1    
#> 3 slideLayout1.xml Title Slide     4  0.5   6.95  2.33 0.399 dt      <p:p… 10   
#> 4 slideLayout1.xml Title Slide     5  3.42  6.95  3.17 0.399 ftr     <p:p… 11   
#> 5 slideLayout1.xml Title Slide     6  7.17  6.95  2.33 0.399 sldNum  <p:p… 12   
#> # ℹ 1 more variable: layout_ph_name <chr>
